items.title: The product of two representable transformations is representable
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file spaces.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for representable transformations a_i : F_i -> G_i, i = 1, 2, the product a_1 x a_2 : F_1 x F_2 -> G_1 x G_2 is representable (source lines 409-420). The proof factors the product through the intermediate F_1 x G_2 and identifies the two factors as base changes of a_1 and a_2 respectively, so that the claim becomes a formal consequence of the stability of representability under base change and composition.
